assumptions: Resolving "two dozen years" to a value in years requires a denomination conversion not represented by F3-v1.

f3_program: collection("governors.commencement_addresses", "commencement_address", "governors", source("commencement addresses did the three of them give altogether"))
member("governors.commencement_addresses", "governor_hawkins.commencement_addresses", source("Governor Sandoval gave twice as many commencement addresses as Governor Hawkins"))
member("governors.commencement_addresses", "governor_sloan.commencement_addresses", source("Governor Sloan gave ten more commencement addresses than Governor Sandoval"))

multiple(at("governor_sandoval.commencement_addresses.count", "first_term"), at("governor_hawkins.commencement_addresses.count", "first_term"), 2, source("Governor Sandoval gave twice as many commencement addresses as Governor Hawkins"))

offset(at("governor_sloan.commencement_addresses.count", "first_term"), at("governor_sandoval.commencement_addresses.count", "first_term"), 10, "count", source("Governor Sloan gave ten more commencement addresses than Governor Sandoval in the same amount of time"))
collection("carousel.attendees", "person", "carousel", source("four clowns and thirty children go on a carousel"))

sum_relation(at("carousel.attendees.count", "this_year"), at("carousel.attendees.clowns.count", "this_year"), at("carousel.attendees.children.count", "this_year"), source("four clowns and thirty children go on a carousel"))

transfer("candy_sale", "candy_seller", at("candy_seller.candies.count", "current"), at("carousel.attendees.candies.count", "current"), scale(at("carousel.attendees.count", "this_year"), 20), source("sold 20 candies, to each of the clowns and the children, who attended"))

transfer("family_hard_taco_purchase", "family", at("taco_truck.hard_shell_tacos.count", "current"), at("family.hard_shell_tacos.count", "current"), 4, source("family that buys four hard shell tacos and three soft tacos"))

transfer("family_soft_taco_purchase", "family", at("taco_truck.soft_tacos.count", "current"), at("family.soft_tacos.count", "current"), 3, source("family that buys four hard shell tacos and three soft tacos"))

transfer("after_family_soft_taco_purchases", "lunch_rush.after_family.customers", at("taco_truck.soft_tacos.count", "current"), at("lunch_rush.after_family.customers.soft_tacos.count", "current"), scale(at("lunch_rush.after_family.customers.count", "lunch_rush"), 2), source("The rest of the customers in the lunch rush only buy two soft tacos each. There were ten customers after the family"))

product_relation(at("spacecraft_gibraltar.people.capacity", "full_capacity"), at("spacecraft_gibraltar.family_units.capacity", "full_capacity"), at("spacecraft_gibraltar.people_per_family.count", "full_capacity"), source("At full capacity, the vehicle can carry 300 family units with four people per family"))

offset(at("spacecraft_gibraltar.people.count", "departure"), fraction(at("spacecraft_gibraltar.people.capacity", "full_capacity"), 1, 3), -100, "count", source("when the spacecraft leaves the earth, it will carry 100 people less than one-third of the ship's capacity"))
